newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key U.S. bond price steady in Tokyo, gains eroded.
newsitem.headline: Key U.S. bond price steady in Tokyo, gains eroded.

text.p: The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond price was steady by midday on Tuesday after profit-taking eroded earlier gains, dealers said.
Brokerage dealers said they could not see any conspicuous buying in early trade, but Japanese investors including major life insurers have recently started buying U.S. Treasury bonds.

"Amid falling yen bond yields and easing fears of a dollar slide, Japanese investors have started buying U.S. bonds, up to the 30-year bonds," said a brokerage dealer. The key 30-year bond due 2027 was at 102-28/32, yielding 6.41 percent, at 0243 GMT, against its 102-29/32 close in New York.
